verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS productivity platform like Motion, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency, or where data is hosted. The CockroachDB engineering discussion is about indexing and says nothing about customer-selectable regions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
